sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects. Both leverage large-scale speech training data and the strong audio understanding capability of their foundation model, Qwen3-Omni. sources.title: TeamUNIVA/qwen3_asr_1.7b_ko - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: English | 한국어 This model is a fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on Korean speech data for automatic speech recognition (ASR), and the successor to TeamUNIVA/qwen3_asr_1.7b_ko_beta. It was initialized from the beta model and further trained with two rounds of SFT followed by reinforcement learning (GSPO) on an expanded dataset.
